headline: Choosing Variable Rate Mortgages Because They're Cheaper Surpasses Fixed Rates in Rise, Borrower Burden Grows
summary: Variable mortgage rates now rise faster than fixed rates for both new loans and outstanding balances. Variable loans make up 65% of new bank mortgage lending, and low-rate loans from five years ago are being repriced.
why: Household mortgage debt is a major channel linking interest-rate moves to consumer spending and bank loan quality in South Korea. Variable-rate loans reprice quickly when benchmark rates change.
